title: 彭博经济：委内瑞拉油田增产需多年，政治变局添变数
speaker: Chris Kennedy

segments.en: In the short term with a possible power change in the US and what a Democrat in the office might want to do especially when you look at it in Venezuela has a you know not the best reputation of stability or long term durability also what is the projection we were looking at this during this initial power transition whatever you want to call it some of the projections for getting these fields up to snuff for like seven to 10 years out is that still the case for some of these larger fields.
segments.zh: 短期内，美国可能发生权力更迭，民主党上台后的政策取向值得关注。委内瑞拉的稳定性和长期持续性声誉不佳。此前预计这些油田达到标准需要7到10年，对于大型油田是否仍然如此？

segments.en: It certainly is I mean this is a very difficult operating environment.
segments.zh: 确实如此，这是一个非常困难的运营环境。

segments.en: Just purely there's a lot of investment above ground challenges so to speak.
segments.zh: 仅从地上挑战来看，就有大量投入需求。

segments.en: But on top of that the oil is difficult to move this is heavy oil it requires a lot of investment to get it to to port to refine it et cetera.
segments.zh: 此外，原油运输困难，属于重油，需要大量投入才能运至港口并提炼。

segments.en: So there's nothing that's changing on those timelines and you're right you're talking about major investments in green field.
segments.zh: 因此时间表没有改变，你提到的绿地项目需要大规模投入。

segments.en: Projects that will take many years to pay off and in that time period we're going to see a political transition in Washington will likely see a political transit transition in Caracas at some point as well so that creates a huge amount of uncertainty for any major company looking to invest.
segments.zh: 这些项目需要多年才能回本，期间华盛顿将出现政治过渡，加拉加斯也可能发生政治更迭，这为任何大型企业的布局带来巨大不确定性。
